paite: Kumpipa in TOUPA'N vai ahawm a; michih ling uhen! Amah cherubte tung ah atu a; leitung ling hen.
heading: Pathian, Kumpipa Tungnung

paite: TOUPA Zion khosung ah thupitak ahi a; michihte tung ah tungnung tham ahi.
Amau na min thupi lauhuaitak phat uhen; amah asiangthou hi.
Kumpipa hatna in vaihawmna a-it a; nang khentuam neihlouhna na hihkip hi, nang Jakobte lak ah vai na hawm a, diktak in na hih hi.
TOUPA i Pathian uh pahtawi unla, akhe ngakna bul ah bia un; amah asiangthou hi.
Asiampute lak ah Mosi leh Aaron, aminloute lak ah Samuel; amau TOUPA asam ua, ama'n adawngta ahi,
meipi dingh ah akiang uah thu agen a, athut athu theihpihte leh thupiakte azui zel uhi.
Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, nang amaute na dawng a; nang amau ngaidampa Pathian na hi, athilhih tung uahte phu la zel mah lechin.
TOUPA i Pathian pahtawi unla, amual siangthou ah bia un; TOUPA i Pathian asiangthou hi.
